articles.title: Jim Cramer says this week's AI sell-off offers a crucial lesson for investors
articles.summary: CNBC's Jim Cramer said Thursday that this week's turbulence in artificial intelligence stocks is delivering a painful reminder of why investors shouldn't put all their money into the market's hottest trade. After months of AI infrastructure stocks leading the market, Cramer said investors who maintained exposure to other sectors are finally seeing the benefits of diversification.

articles.title: Democrat Talarico says he raised record $64 million over summer in Texas Senate race
articles.summary: Democratic Texas Senate candidate James Talarico raised $64 million in the third quarter, his campaign announced Thursday, setting what the campaign said is a Senate fundraising record as Republicans pour outside money into the race to bolster GOP nominee Ken Paxton in the 2026 midterm election.

articles.title: Treasury yields slide as investors flee to safety of bonds amid tech rout
articles.summary: Treasury yields dropped Thursday, as investors continued to cash in technology shares and fled to the safety of bonds following the latest wholesale inflation data. The benchmark 10-year Treasury yield recently tumbled more than 9 basis points to 5.093%, as did the 30-year Treasury bond yield, to 5.425%.
